title: Design seats
source_clause: Subscription renews automatically each year unless written cancellation notice is received thirty days before expiry.

title: Storage locker
source_clause: Lease automatically extends for a further annual term unless either party provides sixty days written non-renewal notice.

title: Exhibition space
source_clause: This fixed term rental expires on the end date and terminates. No automatic extension is offered.

title: Print maintenance
source_clause: Continuation requires a signed renewal purchase order. Both parties must actively agree in writing to a new service term.
